boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 102 flips the usual formula — instead of sliding blocks out, you're placing them in. An empty main grid sits above a bottom inventory of L-shapes and 2×2 clusters, and the step counter tracks each transfer. The puzzle is spatial: fitting every piece cleanly without blocking the middle column, where one misplaced green `1` tile can seal the board.
landmarks: Block Out Level 102 flips the usual formula — instead of sliding blocks out, you're placing them in.
An empty main grid sits above a bottom inventory of L-shapes and 2×2 clusters, and the step counter tracks each transfer.
The puzzle is spatial: fitting every piece cleanly without blocking the middle column, where one misplaced green `1` tile can seal the board.

quickTips: Keep the center column empty until the highlighted green `1` piece is placed.
Watch the step counter — you should reach step 6 before the lower half is fully packed.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drop the first bottom-tray cluster into the upper-left of the main frame to open the run (step 1).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Place the next two clusters along the top row so the center column stays empty.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Move the highlighted green `1` piece through the open center column before filling the lower half.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Transfer the mid-run L-shapes into the left and right lower corners so they do not cross the center lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Place the remaining cyan and purple pairs along the bottom row of the main frame.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the last two-block group from the bottom tray to finish the step-11 completion.

failurePoints: Filling the center column before the green `1` piece is placed — the highlighted piece then has no downward path.
Dropping late L-shapes into the middle of the grid instead of the lower corners, which blocks the final placements.
